name: Better PDF
author: Forsion
description: 读文献用的 PDF 阅读器:选中文字就能高亮、划线、写批注、打标签,也可以在页面上放便签、文字,画方框、圆、箭头;批注列表、目录和 Tangu 对话在右栏。手写和形状用的是白板的同一个引擎,画上去的东西可以点选、拖动、缩放、框选(手写、形状、橡皮需要 2.13.1 之后的桌面版本)。批注存在 PDF 旁边的隐藏文件里,PDF 本身不改,需要时可以另存一份带批注的 PDF。装上后点开 PDF 就由它打开;内置的只读阅读器仍在右键菜单里。
descriptionEn: A PDF reader for working through papers: select text to highlight, underline, comment and tag; place sticky notes and text on the page; draw boxes, ellipses and arrows. The annotation list, the outline and a Tangu chat sit in the right sidebar. Handwriting and shapes use the same engine as the whiteboard, so anything you draw can be selected, moved, resized and box-selected (handwriting, shapes and the eraser need a desktop version newer than 2.13.1). Annotations are saved in a hidden file next to the PDF and the PDF itself is never modified; export a copy with the annotations whenever you need one. Once installed, PDFs open with it; the built-in read-only viewer stays in the right-click menu.

onboarding.intro: 点开库里的任意一份 PDF 就是它。批注跟着 PDF 走,PDF 文件本身不会被改动。

steps.title: 划线与批注
steps.description: 选中一段文字,浮条上点颜色就是高亮;也可以下划线、删除线,或直接写批注。点一条已有的高亮可以改颜色、写评论、打标签。

steps.title: 便签、文字、形状
steps.description: 工具栏上选好工具,在页面上点一下放便签或文字;「形状」拖出方框、圆、箭头或直线(默认方框,不填充),适合圈图表。形状需要 2.13.1 之后的桌面版本。

steps.title: 右栏
steps.description: 批注列表、PDF 目录和 Tangu 对话在右栏的三个标签里;点列表里的一条会跳到它在页面上的位置。

steps.title: 引用到笔记里
steps.description: 「复制引用」把原文、回到这一页的链接和你的评论复制到剪贴板,到哪篇笔记里粘贴都行。

steps.title: 手写与选择
steps.description: 「手写」用的是白板的七支笔。回到「选择」后,画上去的笔迹和形状可以点选、拖动、缩放,从空白处拖一个框能连同划线一起选中,按删除键删掉;橡皮什么都能擦,擦错了点撤销。用手写笔时会自动进入手写笔模式:笔写字,手指只滚动页面。需要 2.13.1 之后的桌面版本;更早的版本上这几个按钮不出现。

en.intro: Open any PDF in your vault and this is what opens it. Annotations travel with the PDF; the PDF file itself is never changed.

steps.title: Highlight and comment
steps.description: Select some text and pick a color on the popup to highlight it; you can also underline, strike through, or write a comment. Click an existing highlight to change its color, add a comment or tag it.

steps.title: Notes, text and shapes
steps.description: Pick a tool on the toolbar, then click the page to place a sticky note or text. The shape tool drags out a box, ellipse, arrow or line (a box by default, no fill), handy for marking figures. Shapes need a desktop version newer than 2.13.1.

steps.title: Right sidebar
steps.description: The annotation list, the PDF outline and a Tangu chat live in three tabs on the right; click an item in the list to jump to its place on the page.

steps.title: Quote into a note
steps.description: "Copy quote" puts the original text, a link back to this page and your comment on the clipboard, ready to paste into any note.

steps.title: Handwriting and selection
steps.description: Handwriting uses the seven pens of the whiteboard. Back in the select tool, strokes and shapes can be selected, moved and resized; drag a box from an empty area to select them together with highlights, then press Delete. The eraser removes anything, and undo brings it back. With a stylus, pen mode turns on by itself: the pen writes and fingers only scroll. These need a desktop version newer than 2.13.1; on earlier versions the buttons do not appear.
